fields.fromStage: stage id, or null when the request is opened
fields.humanDecision: null, or { gate, decision, decidedBy, at } copied from a human reply

postedTo: The request thread named by Lead memory pid.thread.{requestId}

state.sourceOfTruth: Lead memory pid.state.{requestId} holds pid, version, current stage, status, and the thread pointer
state.thread: One thread per request, opened in the intake channel (#er-intake or #new-customer). Human gates are decided in that thread. Lead also posts the gate card to #release-desk so approvers have one queue.
state.otherBots: Specialists store their own slice (estimate, findings, build record) and return it by teammate message. They do not advance pid.state.
